findings.F1: In calm bars (folds B, C), the coin's unusual 5-day move rises with its scaled 7-day move on both sides together: slope t 5.29 over 773 non-overlapping cases. In agitated bars the slope t is -0.33 over 591 cases, and the calm-minus-agitated difference in slope has t 3.24 over 1,364 cases.
findings.F2: The falling side carries as much of the calm continuation as the rising side the tested idea kept. For calm cases with a 7-day fall, the slope t is 3.48 (375 cases), against 2.63 for rises (398 cases). The bottom fifth of the scaled 7-day move is followed by an unusual 5-day move of -2.79 % (t -3.51, 148 cases), the top fifth by +2.51 % (t 2.63, 171 cases).
findings.F3: A shorter 3-day lookback grades the calm continuation most sharply. The two-sided slope t is 5.97 (773 cases), and the slope for 3-day falls alone is 4.91 (370 cases). In agitated bars the same slope t is 0.15.
findings.F4: The calm 3-day-fall slope is positive in every year: t 3.06 in 2018, 2.18 in 2019, 0.83 in 2020 and 0.23 in 2021. The 7-day-fall slope flips sign in 2019 (t -1.17) and 2021 (t -0.59). The 7-day-fall slope is positive on all 6 coins (t from 0.55 to 2.37).
findings.F5: The size of the calm fall continuation is not yet sure, measured short with the cases of one day together.
findings.F6: Longer scaled moves also continue in calm bars and not in agitated ones:
findings.F7: The long-only book's trades are carried by a few large winners: mean +3.25 % net against a median of -0.26 % over 1,399 trades. The top quarter of entry forecasts has the worst median, -1.19 %, so the long side's grading does not show in the trades.

ideas.idea: In a calm market, the larger a coin's 3-day fall measured against its 30-day daily swing, the larger its further fall over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: In calm markets a fall that stands out against the coin's quiet swing is a reason to be short for the next 5 days, more so the larger it is, rather than to buy the dip.
ideas.name: calm scaled fall continues

ideas.idea: In a calm market, a coin's 3-day move measured against its 30-day daily swing carries on in its own direction over the next 5 days, and the larger the scaled move, the larger the follow-through, up or down.
ideas.consequence: In calm markets a trader can side with a short burst on either side for 5 days, sized by how far the burst stands out against the coin's usual swing.
ideas.name: calm short burst follows through

ideas.idea: In a calm market, the larger a coin's 30-day return measured against its 30-day daily swing, the larger its further move in the same direction over the next 5 days, for rises and falls alike.
ideas.consequence: In calm markets a month's scaled trend is a reason to hold its direction for another 5 days, on the short side as well as the long.
ideas.name: calm monthly scaled trend continues
